blocks.content: The Constitution of India is the supreme law of the land.

items: Frequently asked: The 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act (1976) added the words 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity' to the Preamble.
Pay special attention to the sources of different constitutional features borrowed from other nations.
Remember the key distinctions between Fundamental Rights (Part III) and Directive Principles of State Policy (Part IV).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Constituent Assembly took 2 years, 11 months, and 18 days to frame the Indian Constitution.
Dr. B.R. Ambedkar served as the Chairman of the Drafting Committee.
The idea of a Constituent Assembly for India was first put forward by M.N. Roy in 1934.
The Preamble outlines the core values and objectives of the Constitution of India.
